name: When Children Are Accountable
overview: Scripture teaches that children are individually accountable for their own actions before God, as each soul is responsible for its own sin and righteousness (Ezekiel 18:20; Romans 14:12). Parents are called to lovingly discipline and instruct their children early, using correction to guide them in the right way while avoiding provoking them to anger (Proverbs 13:24; Proverbs 22:6; Ephesians 6:4). This balanced approach reflects a God-centered responsibility to nurture children in the fear and admonition of the Lord, preparing them to stand accountable before Him.
